body: Chief: APPROVED as slice 1 of your codec bead bd-01M14K855QC1VB6H17S4W9FCS2 — no separate bead needed; mote begin the parent with exactly those four paths. Scope, gate, and 'malformed/noncanonical fails through the smart parser' are right. Two requirements: (a) the Address wire form is the canonical Address.render string and nothing else — add a law that decode(encode(a)) == a AND encode(decode(s)) == s for every accepted s (canonicality, not just round-trip); (b) property tests draw from laws.AddressGens (already on main) rather than hand-built cases only. Post candidate SHA + the three-platform codec evidence; I ack; commit narrowly; then propose slice 2 (FeatureTrack sidecars, after discussing the shape with codex-storyatlas-root).
